rationale: Single media article documenting Skopje parking payment channels — useful evidence, not a recurring signal feed.
Dominant MK card processor's own site/blog — durable supplier-side source for acceptance and rails mapping.
CaSys e-commerce gateway on a separate domain; docs and feature pages are a standalone gateway-share indicator.
Regional PSP competing in MK e-commerce; product/partner pages track competitive entry over time.
Bank-published instalment merchant roster changes regularly — best public proxy for acquiring/merchant coverage.
Second major bank's instalment merchant roster; cross-bank comparison yields merchant-by-acquirer map.
Closed-loop fuel card page on makpetrol corporate site; monitor via parent domain rather than standalone.
App Store listing gives dated release-note change feed for a fuel chain's payment app features.
One-off article on Nayax entry into MK unattended payments; the outlet itself may be tracked separately.
Single vendor case study naming a Halkbank MK wallet deal — strong evidence, static artifact.
Wallet operator's MK country support page is an authoritative, regularly updated issuer-enablement list.
Wikipedia roster of MK grocery chains — mine once for merchant census seeds, then archive.
Single explainer on toll payment instruments; useful evidence where the road operator publishes little.
Single low-credibility forum thread; candid merchant fee talk but unverifiable and thin.
Statutory NBRSM e-money institution register; failed fetch is likely bot defence, not absence.
Static NBRSM licensing procedure page; covered by monitoring the central bank's payments section.
Index of all PSPS-law bylaws — a dated regulatory-event feed at the core of MK payments monitoring.
Canonical law landing page carrying amendments and consolidated-text links; worth continuous watch.
A single consolidated PDF of the PSPS Law — authoritative evidence; version tracking happens on the parent index.
ENER consultation register is the earliest lead indicator of MK payments regulatory change; monitor the register, not the single item.
Official Gazette is the legal source of record dating every payments regulatory event.
Static ministry PDF compendium; value is as a mirror of consolidated law text, not a producing source.
Consolidated AML law PDF; relevant to cash thresholds but a one-off document.
EPC SEPA participant register names each adhering MK PSP and scheme — dated instant-payments readiness indicator.
Annual EC enlargement assessment on payments-acquis alignment; reliable cadence and independent cross-check.
ERP 2025-2027 PDF gives dated payments reform milestones; a periodic document, not a live feed.
Recurring NBRSM payments conference publishes figures and policy intent not otherwise disclosed.
One 2023 trade-press interview; useful for the actor map and attribution only.
